comments.body:
North Africa was Christian before the Mohammedan Arabs invaded.

St. Augustine - one of the most important Christian philosophers, who has influenced ALL later western philosophy and theology, was a Berber born in Algeria and he lived many years in Carthage, which is pretty much Tunis.
